The Vivitar V3800N is a Pentax K mount manual-focus 35mm SLR announced by Vivitar beginning in 2001, A [https://www.shutterbug.com/content/35mm-slr-cameras-lenses-and-flashes Shutterbug magazine article] reports it appearing at the February 2001 PMA show in Orlando, Florida.New York retailer Adorama was distributing the camera through the early 2000s.
